The router (app.tsx), the per-page <PageSeo> head tags, the build-time sitemap and prerender.py's route list all read this file, so a page cannot ship un-prerendered or missing from the sitemap. prerender.py reads it as plain JSON, which is why the registry is JSON and not TypeScript. Add a route here FIRST, then add its <Route> and its page component.
